about_the_game:
"Gensou Korokoro" is a Touhou Project fan-made deck-building card game!

With over 150 cards and a wide variety of characters to choose from, build your ultimate deck and claim the Hakurei Shrine before anyone else!

What is a Deck-Building Game?

At the start of the game, players have no cards.
During play, you’ll acquire new cards and strengthen your deck as the match progresses.
Carefully watching what cards your opponent collects and building your own deck strategically is key to victory!

“Deck-building games sound complicated...”

Gensou Korokoro is perfect even for beginners to the genre.
While card synergy matters, most cards are designed to work effectively on their own,
so you don’t need to read tons of complex text.
(You can play it intuitively!)

Game Features

  • Your cards activate based on dice rolls, but many cards can be used regardless of the result—giving you a wide range of deck-building strategies.

  • Players select six characters to bring into battle, allowing you to play with your favorites.
    (No need to fight over characters with other players!)

  • With hundreds of cards and numerous supply setups, the game offers endless replayability.

  • The Weather System adds unique effects every turn, randomly changing the battlefield—
    meaning there’s no fixed “winning combo”, and you’ll need to adapt your deck to every new situation.

  • Enjoy both quick matches against random opponents and lobby matches where you can battle with friends.

Original Work © Team Shanghai Alice
"Gensou Korokoro" is a Touhou Project derivative work.
